decision.rationale: Advance T1 only to one separately frozen confirmation because every synthetic network-free development gate passed. This is a development-method decision, not release-profile promotion; T0 remains the active staging configuration and rollback.
limitations: The ten trajectories are synthetic development cases and are not an untouched confirmation set.
The deterministic generator and turn signals do not establish model-based learner-state interpretation or natural tutoring quality.
The run does not establish professor fidelity, student learning, human usability, provider reliability, or hosted latency.
T1 remains rejected by staging configuration and requires a separate confirmation decision before release selection.
